source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 17 (PDF 85-117), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 17 (Alternating Current) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har 5 number ke theory sawal (definition, wazahat, derivation) ke baad usi mauzu ka 3 number ka numerical hai. Har sawal ka model jawab hai; numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is alternating current? State the conditions for a voltage to be alternating. Define the peak, peak-to-peak, average and rms values of an alternating voltage and write their relations with the peak value. (5 marks)
(Alternating current kya hai? Voltage ke alternating hone ki sharait bayan karein. Alternating voltage ki peak, peak-to-peak, average aur rms qeematein define karein aur peak qeemat se in ke taaluqaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Alternating current: sine ya cosine ki tarah waqt ke saath badalne wali current. AC generator ka emf
V = Vₒ sin ωt ... (17.1), isi tarah I = Iₒ sin ωt
jahan Vₒ maximum voltage aur ω angular frequency (zaaviyai frequency) hai.

Sharait: (i) har cycle (aik time period T) ke do bilkul yaksaan half-cycles hon, aik positive aik negative, yani har half-cycle ke baad current ka rukh (voltage ki polarity) ulat jaye; (ii) dono taraf peak qeemat har cycle mein aik jaisi rahe. Tabdeeli zero points par sab se tez aur peak par sab se aahista hoti hai.

Lamhati qeemat: V = Vₒ sin ωt; ω = 2π/T aur f = 1/T se V = Vₒ sin (2πft).

Peak qeemat (Vₒ, Iₒ): aik cycle mein sab se oonchi qeemat.
Peak-to-peak qeemat: positive se negative peak tak faasla; Vp-p = 2Vₒ.
Average qeemat: poore cycle ka average zero hai kyunke dono halves khatam ho jaate hain, is liye aadhe cycle (0 se π) par li jati hai. Full-wave rectified sine wave ke liye Iₐᵥ = 0.637 Iₒ aur Vₐᵥ = 0.637 Vₒ.
rms qeemat: woh constant current (voltage) jo resistor mein AC jitni hi power paida kare:
Iᵣₘₛ = Iₒ/√2 = 0.707 Iₒ ... (17.3)
Vᵣₘₛ = Vₒ/√2 = 0.707 Vₒ ... (17.4)

book_ref.quote: The emf of an AC generator is given by the following equation, for voltage:

blocks.prompt:
2 A 50 Hz supply has an rms voltage of 230 V. Find (i) its peak value (ii) its peak-to-peak value (iii) the half-cycle average value (iv) the instantaneous voltage at t = 1/600 s, taking V = 0 at t = 0. (3 marks)
(50 Hz supply ka rms voltage 230 V hai. Nikalein (i) peak qeemat (ii) peak-to-peak qeemat (iii) aadhe cycle ki average qeemat (iv) t = 1/600 s par lamhati voltage, jab t = 0 par V = 0 ho.)
blocks.explanation: rms se peak Vₒ = Vᵣₘₛ/0.707 se nikalein, phir 2Vₒ, 0.637 Vₒ aur V = Vₒ sin (2πft) lagayein.

book_ref.quote: rms values represent the direct current, or voltage, values that will produce the same heating effect

blocks.prompt:
3 Define instantaneous power and mean power in an AC circuit. Show that for a sinusoidal current in a resistive load the mean power is half the maximum power, and explain the reason physically. (5 marks)
(AC circuit mein instantaneous power aur mean power define karein. Sabit karein ke resistive load mein sinusoidal current ke liye mean power maximum power ka aadha hai, aur is ki tabeei wajah bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Resistive load capacitor ya inductor ki tarah energy store nahi karta; sirf hararat ki shakal mein kharch karta hai.

Instantaneous power: kisi lamhe t par power,
P = VI ... (17.5)
jahan V aur I lamhati voltage aur current hain. Maximum power tab hoti hai jab V aur I peak Vₒ aur Iₒ par hon.
Mean power: AC waveform ke aik poore cycle par average power.

Taaluq: Resistance R mein peak current Iₒ wali sinusoidal AC ke liye
Pₘₐₓ = Iₒ²R ... (17.6)
Pₘₑₐₙ = Iᵣₘₛ²R ... (17.7)
Kyunke Iₒ = √2 Iᵣₘₛ, Eq. 17.6 ban jati hai
Pₘₐₓ = (√2 Iᵣₘₛ)²R = 2Iᵣₘₛ²R
Eq. 17.7 se Iᵣₘₛ²R = Pₘₑₐₙ, is liye
Pₘₐₓ = 2Pₘₑₐₙ, yani Pₘₑₐₙ = Pₘₐₓ/2 ... (17.8)

Wajah: lamhati power cycle mein badalti hai; sirf kuch points par maximum hoti hai aur kaafi waqt zero ya kam qeematon par rehti hai, is liye is ka average peak ka aadha hai.

book_ref.quote: Therefore, it can be concluded that the mean power in a resistive load is half the maximum power

blocks.prompt:
4 A sinusoidal current of peak value 4 A flows through a 60 Ω resistor. Find (i) the maximum power (ii) the mean power (iii) the rms current, and check that Iᵣₘₛ²R gives the same mean power. (3 marks)
(Peak qeemat 4 A wali sinusoidal current 60 Ω resistor mein behti hai. Nikalein (i) maximum power (ii) mean power (iii) rms current, aur check karein ke Iᵣₘₛ²R wohi mean power deta hai.)
blocks.explanation: Pₘₐₓ = Iₒ²R lagayein, phir aadha karein; Iᵣₘₛ = 0.707 Iₒ nikal kar Pₘₑₐₙ = Iᵣₘₛ²R se check karein.

book_ref.quote: The maximum or peak Pₘₐₓ occurs when the current and voltage are at their peak values

blocks.final_answer: Pₘₐₓ = 960 W; Pₘₑₐₙ = 480 W; Iᵣₘₛ = 2.83 A (Iᵣₘₛ²R ≈ 480 W, jaisa hona chahiye)

blocks.prompt:
5 Discuss the flow of AC through a pure resistor. Show that the voltage and current are in phase, draw (in words) its vector diagram, and obtain the expressions for instantaneous and average power. (5 marks)
(Khaalis resistor mein AC ke bahao par bahas karein. Sabit karein ke voltage aur current in phase hain, is ka vector diagram (alfaaz mein) bayan karein, aur lamhati aur average power ke formulas hasil karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Resistor R ko AC source se joda gaya hai. Lamhati voltage
V = Vₒ sin ωt ... (17.10)
Lamhati current I = V/R. Eq. 17.10 se
I = (Vₒ sin ωt)/R
I = Iₒ sin ωt ... (17.11)
jahan Iₒ = Vₒ/R peak current hai.

Phase: Eq. 17.10 aur 17.11 aik hi ωt ke sine functions hain, is liye V aur I aik hi waqt maximum aur minimum se guzarte hain: in phase hain.
Vector diagram: V_R aur I_R parallel banaye jaate hain kyunke in mein phase farq nahi. Mukhalfat resistance R = V/I hai.

Power: power I² ke mutanasib hai, is liye DC ya AC se farq nahi parta. Magar peak Iₒ wali AC har half-cycle mein sirf aik lamhe ke liye Iₒ par hoti hai, is liye Iₒ wali DC se kam hararat deti hai. Lamhati power:
P = VI ya P = I²R ya P = V²/R ... (17.12)
Average power: ⟨P⟩ = ⟨I²R⟩. Kyunke ⟨I²⟩ = Iₒ²/2 = Iᵣₘₛ²,
⟨P⟩ = (Iₒ²/2)R = Iᵣₘₛ²R, aur ⟨P⟩ = IᵣₘₛVᵣₘₛ
P watt, V volt, I ampere aur R ohm mein; Eq. 17.12 sirf tab durust hai jab V aur I in phase hon.

book_ref.quote: A resistor R connected with an AC source is shown in Fig.17.6 (a).

blocks.prompt:
6 A 1.5 kW heating element works on a 230 V rms AC supply. Find (i) the rms current taken (ii) the resistance of the element when hot (iii) the peak current. (3 marks)
(1.5 kW heating element 230 V rms AC supply par chalta hai. Nikalein (i) li jane wali rms current (ii) garam halat mein element ki resistance (iii) peak current.)
blocks.explanation: Resistor mein V aur I in phase hain, is liye rms qeematon ke saath P = VI; phir R = V/I aur Iₒ = Iᵣₘₛ/0.707.

book_ref.quote: Calculate the amount of current taken from the supply and the resistance of the element when it is hot.

blocks.prompt:
7 An AC source of frequency f is connected to a pure inductor L. Show that the voltage across the inductor leads the current by π/2, obtain the expression for its reactance, and explain why an inductor allows DC but opposes AC. (5 marks)
(Frequency f wala AC source khaalis inductor L se joda gaya hai. Sabit karein ke inductor par voltage current se π/2 aage hai, is ki reactance ka formula hasil karein, aur bayan karein ke inductor DC ko guzarne aur AC ki mukhalfat kyun karta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Inductor (coil ya choke) do terminal wala passive component hai jis ki self-inductance bari aur resistance na hone ke barabar hai; yeh magnetic field mein energy store karta hai.

Current I = Iₒ sin ωt ... (17.13)
Badalti current back emf V = L ΔI/Δt paida karti hai. Applied voltage is back emf ke barabar hona chahiye:
V = L (Δ/Δt)(Iₒ sin ωt) = LIₒ (Δ/Δt) sin ωt ... (17.14)
Kyunke (Δ/Δt) sin ωt = ω cos ωt,
V = ωLIₒ cos ωt
Kyunke ωLIₒ = Vₒ, V = Vₒ cos ωt
Kyunke cos ωt = sin (ωt + π/2),
V = Vₒ sin (ωt + π/2) ... (17.15)
Yani L par voltage current se 90° (π/2 rad) aage hai; current hamesha voltage se 90° peeche hai.

Inductive reactance: X_L = Vᵣₘₛ/Iᵣₘₛ ... (17.16)
Vᵣₘₛ = 0.707 Vₒ aur Iᵣₘₛ = 0.707 Iₒ se X_L = Vₒ/Iₒ
Vₒ = ωLIₒ se X_L = ωLIₒ/Iₒ
X_L = ωL = 2πfL ... (17.17)
Unit ohm hai. X_L, f aur L dono ke seedha mutanasib hai.

DC aur AC: DC ke liye f = 0, to X_L = 0, inductor DC guzarta hai. Zyada frequency wali AC ke liye X_L bari, inductor AC ko rokta hai. 90° phase farq ki wajah se khaalis inductor average power kharch nahi karta; is liye energy zaya kiye baghair AC control karne ke kaam aata hai.

book_ref.quote: Suppose an inductor of inductance L is connected with an AC source of frequency f

blocks.prompt:
8 A coil of inductance 0.5 H and negligible resistance is connected to a 220 V, 50 Hz supply. Find (i) its reactance (ii) the rms current. (iii) What would the current be if the frequency were 100 Hz? (3 marks)
(0.5 H inductance aur na hone ke barabar resistance wali coil 220 V, 50 Hz supply se jodi gayi. Nikalein (i) is ki reactance (ii) rms current. (iii) Agar frequency 100 Hz ho to current kitni hogi?)
blocks.explanation: X_L = 2πfL, phir I = V/X_L; f dugni to X_L dugni aur current aadhi.

book_ref.quote: while in case of large AC frequency, X_L is also large

blocks.final_answer: X_L = 157.1 Ω; 50 Hz par Iᵣₘₛ = 1.40 A aur 100 Hz par 0.700 A

blocks.prompt:
9 What is a choke? Explain why a choke coil dissipates practically no power, and describe its uses in circuits. (5 marks)
(Choke kya hai? Wazahat karein ke choke coil amalan koi power kyun kharch nahi karti, aur circuits mein is ke istemal bayan karein.)

book_ref.quote: A choke is often modeled as a series RL-circuit

blocks.prompt:
10 A choke of inductance 0.8 H and resistance 2 Ω is connected to a 220 V, 50 Hz supply. Find (i) its reactance (ii) the phase angle and power factor (iii) the current and the power dissipated. (3 marks)
(0.8 H inductance aur 2 Ω resistance wala choke 220 V, 50 Hz supply se joda gaya. Nikalein (i) is ki reactance (ii) phase angle aur power factor (iii) current aur kharch hone wali power.)
blocks.explanation: Choke ko series RL samjhein: X_L = 2πfL, θ = tan⁻¹(ωL/R), Z = √(R² + X_L²), I = V/Z aur P = I²R.

book_ref.quote: As the resistance R of a choke coil is negligibly small

blocks.final_answer: X_L = 251.3 Ω; θ = 89.5°, power factor ≈ 0.008; I = 0.875 A; sirf 1.53 W kharch hoti hai

blocks.prompt:
11 Explain how alternating current flows through a circuit containing a capacitor. Prove that the current leads the applied voltage by a quarter of a cycle, and derive the capacitive reactance. How does it vary with frequency? (5 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke capacitor wale circuit mein alternating current kaise behti hai. Sabit karein ke current applied voltage se chauthai cycle aage hai, aur capacitive reactance ka formula hasil karein. Yeh frequency ke saath kaise badalti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Capacitor plates ke darmiyan insulating medium ki wajah se DC nahi guzarta. Alternating voltage lagane par capacitor pehle aik rukh aur voltage ulatne par doosre rukh charge hota hai; electrons circuit mein aage peeche chalte hain, yahi AC hai.

V = Vₒ sin ωt ... (17.18)
q = CV har lamhe durust hai, is liye q = CVₒ sin ωt.
I = Δq/Δt = (Δ/Δt)(CVₒ sin ωt) = CVₒ (Δ/Δt)(sin ωt)
Kyunke (Δ/Δt) sin ωt = ω cos ωt,
I = ωCVₒ cos ωt
Kyunke cos ωt = sin (ωt + π/2),
I = ωCVₒ sin (ωt + π/2)
Yahan ωCVₒ = Iₒ, is liye
I = Iₒ sin (ωt + π/2) ... (17.19)
Eq. 17.18 aur 17.19 se capacitor ki current voltage se 90° (π/2 rad, chauthai cycle) aage hai, yani voltage current se peeche hai.

Capacitive reactance: X_C = Vᵣₘₛ/Iᵣₘₛ
Vᵣₘₛ = 0.707 Vₒ aur Iᵣₘₛ = 0.707 Iₒ se X_C = Vₒ/Iₒ
Iₒ = ωCVₒ se
X_C = 1/ωC = 1/(2πfC), jahan ω = 2πf. Unit: ohm.

Frequency: kam frequency par X_C bari aur current kam; zyada frequency par X_C chhoti aur current zyada. DC ke liye f = 0 aur X_C = ∞, is liye capacitor DC ko rokta hai.

book_ref.quote: The basic relationship between charge q and the voltage V across the plates

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'inductor current leads' likhti hai; durust yeh hai ke capacitor ki current voltage se aage hai. Inductor mein current voltage se peeche hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
12 A 4 μF capacitor is connected to a 220 V rms supply. Find its reactance and the rms current (i) at 50 Hz (ii) at 500 Hz. (3 marks)
(4 μF capacitor 220 V rms supply se joda gaya. Is ki reactance aur rms current nikalein (i) 50 Hz par (ii) 500 Hz par.)
blocks.explanation: X_C = 1/(2πfC), phir I = V/X_C; das guna frequency par reactance dasvan hissa aur current das guna.

book_ref.quote: Which shows that for low frequencies, capacitor will have a large reactance

blocks.prompt:
13 Define impedance. A resistor R and a capacitor C are connected in series to an AC source. Using the voltage phasors, derive the impedance of the circuit and the phase angle between voltage and current, and write the power consumed. (5 marks)
(Impedance define karein. Resistor R aur capacitor C AC source ke saath series mein hain. Voltage phasors se circuit ki impedance aur voltage aur current ke darmiyan phase angle hasil karein, aur kharch hone wali power likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Impedance: AC circuit mein resistance aur reactances ka mila jula asar; Z = Vᵣₘₛ/Iᵣₘₛ ... (17.20), SI unit ohm.

RC series: R aur C series mein hain, is liye dono mein aik hi current; current ko reference lein.
R par voltage: V_R = IᵣₘₛR, current ke saath in phase (current line ke saath).
C par voltage: V_C = IᵣₘₛX_C = Iᵣₘₛ/ωC, current se 90° peeche (current line par amood).
Applied voltage vector resultant hai:
Vᵣₘₛ = √(V_R² + V_C²)
Vᵣₘₛ = √((IᵣₘₛR)² + (Iᵣₘₛ/ωC)²)
Vᵣₘₛ = Iᵣₘₛ√(R² + (1/ωC)²)
Impedance Z = Vᵣₘₛ/Iᵣₘₛ = √(R² + (1/ωC)²) ... (17.21)

Impedance diagram: R current ke saath horizontal line; X_C = 1/ωC, R line se 90° peeche; Z dono ka vector jama. Z ka R line se angle θ phase farq hai; current applied voltage se aage hai:
θ = tan⁻¹(X_C/R) = tan⁻¹(1/ωCR) = tan⁻¹(1/2πfCR)

Power: capacitor sirf energy store karta hai, zaya nahi karta, is liye power resistor mein kharch hoti hai:
P = I²R, ya P = VI cos θ ... (17.22)

book_ref.quote: Consider a network of resistance R and a capacitor C connected in series

blocks.prompt:
14 A 300 Ω resistor and a 10 μF capacitor are connected in series across a 220 V, 50 Hz supply. Find (i) the capacitive reactance (ii) the impedance and current (iii) the phase angle (iv) the power consumed. (3 marks)
(300 Ω resistor aur 10 μF capacitor 220 V, 50 Hz supply par series mein hain. Nikalein (i) capacitive reactance (ii) impedance aur current (iii) phase angle (iv) kharch hone wali power.)
blocks.explanation: X_C nikal kar R ke saath vector jama se Z, phir I = V/Z, θ = tan⁻¹(X_C/R) aur P = I²R.

book_ref.quote: A resistor of resistance 5 kΩ is connected in series with capacitor

blocks.prompt:
15 A resistor R and an inductor L are connected in series with an AC source. Derive the impedance of the circuit and the phase angle between the applied voltage and current. What is power factor, and where is the power consumed? (5 marks)
(Resistor R aur inductor L AC source ke saath series mein hain. Circuit ki impedance aur applied voltage aur current ke darmiyan phase angle hasil karein. Power factor kya hai, aur power kahan kharch hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
R aur L series mein hain, is liye dono mein aik hi current.
R par voltage: V_R = IᵣₘₛR, current ke saath in phase (line OA).
L par voltage: V_L = IᵣₘₛX_L, current se 90° aage (line OB).
Resultant voltage in ka vector jama (line OP):
Vᵣₘₛ = √(V_R² + V_L²)
Vᵣₘₛ = √((IᵣₘₛR)² + (IᵣₘₛX_L)²) = Iᵣₘₛ√(R² + X_L²)
X_L = ωL se Vᵣₘₛ = Iᵣₘₛ√(R² + (ωL)²)
Impedance Z = Vᵣₘₛ/Iᵣₘₛ = √(R² + (ωL)²) ... (17.23)
Phase angle: Z ka R line se angle θ phase farq hai; voltage current se aage hai:
θ = tan⁻¹(ωL/R)

Power: inductor energy store karta hai magar ideal halat mein zaya nahi karta, is liye power resistor mein kharch hoti hai:
P = I²R = VI cos θ
cos θ power factor hai. DC power (maslan solar panel) ko AC mein badalte waqt inverter efficiency (aam tor par 85% se 90%) shamil ki jati hai: P_ac = (inverter efficiency) × P_dc.

book_ref.quote: The resultant voltage V will be the vector sum of V_R and V_L shown vectorially by line OP

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ki aik line mein squares bracket ke andar chhap gaye hain; durust yeh hai: Vᵣₘₛ = √((IᵣₘₛR)² + (IᵣₘₛX_L)²) = Iᵣₘₛ√(R² + X_L²).

blocks.prompt:
16 A 40 Ω resistor and a 0.1 H inductor are connected in series across a 220 V, 50 Hz supply. Find (i) the impedance (ii) the current (iii) the phase angle and power factor (iv) the power consumed. (3 marks)
(40 Ω resistor aur 0.1 H inductor 220 V, 50 Hz supply par series mein hain. Nikalein (i) impedance (ii) current (iii) phase angle aur power factor (iv) kharch hone wali power.)
blocks.explanation: X_L = 2πfL, phir Z, I = V/Z, θ = tan⁻¹(X_L/R); power I²R hai jo VI cos θ ke barabar hai.

book_ref.quote: where I, R and V represents current, resistance, and voltage respectively

blocks.final_answer: Z = 50.9 Ω; I = 4.33 A; θ = 38.1° (voltage aage), power factor 0.786; P = 748 W

blocks.prompt:
17 Write the impedance of an RLC-series circuit and explain its behaviour at high and low frequencies. Derive the resonance frequency, and state the properties of the circuit at resonance. (5 marks)
(RLC-series circuit ki impedance likhein aur zyada aur kam frequency par is ka bartao bayan karein. Resonance frequency hasil karein aur resonance par circuit ki khoobiyan bayan karein.)

book_ref.quote: Consider a RLC-series circuit having an alternating voltage source with variable frequency

blocks.prompt:
18 An RLC-series circuit has R = 20 Ω, L = 0.2 H and C = 50 μF and is connected to a 100 V rms source of variable frequency. Find (i) the resonance frequency (ii) the current at resonance (iii) the impedance and current at 100 Hz. (3 marks)
(RLC-series circuit mein R = 20 Ω, L = 0.2 H aur C = 50 μF hain aur yeh badalti frequency wale 100 V rms source se juda hai. Nikalein (i) resonance frequency (ii) resonance par current (iii) 100 Hz par impedance aur current.)
blocks.explanation: fᵣ = 1/(2π√LC) lagayein; resonance par Z = R; resonance se hat kar X_L aur X_C nikal kar Z = √(R² + (X_L − X_C)²).

book_ref.quote: The impedance diagram of RLC-series circuit is shown in Fig.17.11(b)

steps: (ii) Resonance par Z = R = 20 Ω; I = 100/20 = 5 A
(iii) 100 Hz par: X_L = 125.7 Ω; X_C = 31.8 Ω
blocks.final_answer: fᵣ = 50.3 Hz; resonance par I = 5 A; 100 Hz par Z = 95.9 Ω aur I = 1.04 A (wahan circuit inductive hai)

blocks.prompt:
19 Write the impedance of an RLC-parallel circuit. Compare the behaviour of RLC-series and RLC-parallel circuits at resonance, and explain admittance, current magnification and the quality factor of the parallel circuit. (5 marks)
(RLC-parallel circuit ki impedance likhein. Resonance par RLC-series aur RLC-parallel circuits ke bartao ka muqabla karein, aur parallel circuit ki admittance, current magnification aur quality factor ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
RLC-parallel circuit mein R, L aur C AC source ke saath parallel hain; sab par voltage aik jaisa hai, is liye use reference phasor liya jata hai. Impedance
Z = 1/√((1/R)² + (1/X_L − 1/X_C)²) ... (17.28)
Yeh X_L = X_C par resonate karta hai, jahan doosra term zero ho kar Z = R zyada se zyada hoti hai; circuit khaalis resistive. Resonance frequency fᵣ = 1/(2π√LC), aur resonance par power factor aik hai.

Admittance: Y impedance ka ulat hai; parallel RLC ki kul admittance components ki admittances ka jama hai.
Current magnification: resonance par source current kam se kam, magar branch currents I_L aur I_C har aik resonance current Iᵣ se zyada ho sakti hain.
Quality factor: Q resonance peak ki tezi ka paimana (store energy ka zaya energy se muqabla); parallel circuit mein Q = R√(C/L), yani R barhne se Q barhta hai.
Istemal: tuning circuits, signal processing, power systems aur induction cooktops.

Resonance par muqabla (table).

book_ref.quote: The impedance, admittance, and currents in a parallel RLC-circuit are all frequency-dependent.

rows: R, L aur C mein aik hi current.
R, L aur C par aik hi voltage.
Impedance kam se kam, Z = R.
Impedance zyada se zyada, Z = R.
L aur C par voltage amplification.
L aur C ki branches mein current magnification.
R barhne se Q ghatta hai.
R barhne se Q barhta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab is masawat ko (17.27) number deti hai jo pehle P = VI cos θ ke liye aa chuka; yeh (17.28) hai. Kitab parallel circuit ke Q ko R ke ulat mutanasib kehti hai; durust yeh hai ke parallel mein Q = R√(C/L), R ke seedha mutanasib.

blocks.prompt:
20 An RLC-parallel circuit has R = 100 Ω. Find its impedance (i) at resonance, where X_L = X_C (ii) at a frequency where X_L = 40 Ω and X_C = 60 Ω. Which is larger? (3 marks)
(RLC-parallel circuit mein R = 100 Ω hai. Is ki impedance nikalein (i) resonance par, jahan X_L = X_C (ii) us frequency par jahan X_L = 40 Ω aur X_C = 60 Ω. Kaun si bari hai?)
blocks.explanation: Z = 1/√((1/R)² + (1/X_L − 1/X_C)²) lagayein; resonance par X_L aur X_C wala hissa zero hai.

book_ref.quote: The resonance frequency of RLC-parallel circuit is:

steps: 100 Ω > 76.8 Ω, is liye resonance par impedance zyada se zyada hai
blocks.final_answer: Resonance par Z = 100 Ω aur hat kar 76.8 Ω: parallel circuit ki impedance resonance par zyada se zyada hai

blocks.prompt:
21 What is rectification? Describe the working of a half-wave rectifier with its input and output waveforms. Explain how a smoothing capacitor reduces the ripple in a rectifier output and write the expression for the ripple voltage. (5 marks)
(Rectification kya hai? Half-wave rectifier ka kaam input aur output waveforms ke saath bayan karein. Wazahat karein ke smoothing capacitor rectifier ke output mein ripple kaise kam karta hai aur ripple voltage ka formula likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Rectification: AC ko DC mein badalne ka amal. Diode forward bias mein bari current aur reverse bias mein amalan zero current guzarta hai, is liye rectification ke kaam aata hai. Do qismein: half-wave aur full-wave.

Half-wave rectifier: period T wala alternating input voltage diode D ko diya jata hai jo load resistance R_L ke series mein hai.
(i) 0 → T/2 (positive half-cycle): D forward bias, bohat kam resistance, R_L mein current behti hai; R_L par voltage input ke mutabiq badalta hai.
(ii) T/2 → T (negative half-cycle): D reverse bias, bohat zyada resistance, amalan current nahi aur R_L par voltage taqreeban zero.
Har cycle mein yahi hota hai. R_L mein current aik rukh mein (DC) magar pulses mein. Input: poori sine wave; output: sirf positive half-cycles, darmiyan mein zero. R_L par voltage output voltage hai.

Smoothing: rectified output pulsating DC hai jo aksar devices ke liye mozoon nahi. Capacitor filter mein capacitor load ke parallel hota hai. Voltage barhne par charge aur ghatne par discharge hota hai, output hamwar aur average DC satah oonchi. Full-wave bridge rectifier ke liye ripple voltage
V_ripple = I_DC/(f_ripple C) = I_DC/(2fC), aur f_ripple = 2f
jahan I_DC load current, f input frequency aur C capacitance hai. C bara ho to ripple kam.

book_ref.quote: The working of half-wave rectifier is based on the fact that the diode allows the current flow only in one direction.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke ripple smoothing capacitor par munhasir nahi; magar formula hi batata hai ke C barhane se V_ripple kam hota hai. Ripple C, frequency aur load current teeno par munhasir hai.

blocks.prompt:
22 A full-wave bridge rectifier works on a 50 Hz supply and gives a load current of 0.2 A. Find (i) the ripple frequency (ii) the ripple voltage with a 470 μF smoothing capacitor (iii) the ripple voltage if the capacitor is 940 μF. (iv) Without smoothing, what is the average output if the peak output is 12 V? (3 marks)
(Full-wave bridge rectifier 50 Hz supply par 0.2 A load current deta hai. Nikalein (i) ripple frequency (ii) 470 μF smoothing capacitor ke saath ripple voltage (iii) 940 μF capacitor ke saath ripple voltage. (iv) Smoothing ke baghair, peak output 12 V ho to average output kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ripple frequency 2f hai; V_ripple = I_DC/(2fC); full-wave rectified sine ka average 0.637 Vₒ hai.

book_ref.quote: The maximum ripple voltage present in a full-wave rectifier bridge circuit

blocks.final_answer: f_ripple = 100 Hz; 470 μF par V_ripple = 4.26 V aur 940 μF par 2.13 V (C dugna, ripple aadha); Vₐᵥ = 7.64 V

blocks.prompt:
23 What is self-induction? Show that the self-induced emf is ε_L = −L ΔI/Δt and that L = N Δφ/ΔI. On what factors does self-inductance depend? Define the henry. (5 marks)
(Self-induction kya hai? Sabit karein ke self-induced emf ε_L = −L ΔI/Δt hai aur L = N Δφ/ΔI. Self-inductance kin cheezon par munhasir hai? Henry define karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Aik coil battery, switch aur rheostat ke series mein hai. Rheostat tezi se hilane par coil ki current badalti hai, coil ka magnetic flux badalta hai, aur coil mein hi emf induce hota hai.
Self-induction: woh amal jis mein badalti current usi coil mein emf induce kare.

Aik loop ka flux φ ho to N turns ka flux Nφ. φ field ke mutanasib aur field I ke mutanasib hai,
Nφ ∝ I, is liye Nφ = LI ... (17.29)
jahan L coil ki self-inductance hai.
Faraday's law se
ε_L = −N Δφ/Δt ... (17.30)
ε_L = −Δ(Nφ)/Δt
Eq. 17.29 se ε_L = −Δ(LI)/Δt
ε_L = −L ΔI/Δt ... (17.31)
ya L = −ε_L/(ΔI/Δt) ... (17.32)
Minus sign batata hai ke induced emf applied voltage ki mukhalfat karta hai.
Eq. 17.30 aur 17.31 barabar karne se: −N Δφ/Δt = −L ΔI/Δt, is liye
L = N Δφ/ΔI ... (17.33)

Factors: (i) turns ki tadaad, (ii) cross-section ka area, (iii) core material; ferromagnetic iron core hawa ke muqable mein flux aur inductance bohat barha deta hai.

Henry: agar current 1 A s⁻¹ se badalne par coil mein 1 V induce ho to us ki self-inductance 1 H hai. Unit V s A⁻¹; dimensions [ML²T⁻²A⁻²].

book_ref.quote: If we move the rheostat quickly, the primary current through the coil will change.

blocks.prompt:
24 The current in a coil of 500 turns and self-inductance 0.3 H rises steadily from 2 A to 6 A in 0.05 s. Find (i) the rate of change of current (ii) the magnitude of the self-induced emf (iii) the change of flux through each turn. (3 marks)
(500 turns aur 0.3 H self-inductance wali coil mein current 0.05 s mein yaksaan tor par 2 A se 6 A tak barhti hai. Nikalein (i) current ki tabdeeli ki raftaar (ii) self-induced emf ki miqdaar (iii) har turn ke flux mein tabdeeli.)
blocks.explanation: ΔI/Δt nikalein, phir |ε_L| = L ΔI/Δt; L = N Δφ/ΔI se Δφ = L ΔI/N.

book_ref.quote: The self-inductance of the coil can also be defined as ratio of the emf to the rate of change of current

blocks.final_answer: ΔI/Δt = 80 A s⁻¹; |ε_L| = 24 V (barhne ki mukhalfat mein); har turn Δφ = 2.4 × 10⁻³ Wb

blocks.prompt:
25 Show that the energy stored in an inductor carrying current I is ½LI². Hence show that the energy stored per unit volume in the magnetic field of a solenoid is B²/2μₒ. (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke current I wale inductor mein store energy ½LI² hai. Phir sabit karein ke solenoid ke magnetic field mein fi unit volume energy B²/2μₒ hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Aik coil battery aur switch ke series mein hai. Switch ON karne par current zero se maximum I tak barhti hai. Badalti current battery ke mukhalif emf induce karti hai aur battery is ke khilaf charges ko chalane mein kaam karti hai.

Charge Δq ke liye kaam: W = Δq ε_L ... (17.34)
ε_L = L ΔI/Δt ke saath
W = Δq L ΔI/Δt = (Δq/Δt) L ΔI ... (17.35)
Δq/Δt woh average current hai jab current 0 se I tak barhti hai: Δq/Δt = (0 + I)/2 = ½I, aur ΔI = I − 0 = I.
Eq. 17.35 mein rakhne se
W = (½I)LI = ½LI² ... (17.36)
Yeh kaam inductor mein potential energy ban kar store hota hai:
U_m = ½LI² ... (17.37)
Yeh magnetic field mein store hoti hai aur I² ke mutanasib hone ki wajah se kabhi negative nahi hoti.

Energy density: solenoid jis mein fi unit lambai n turns, cross-section A aur lambai l ho,
B = μₒnI, is liye I = B/μₒn, aur L = μₒn²Al
U_m = ½ μₒn²Al (B/μₒn)²
U_m = (B²/2μₒ)(Al)
Al = volume, is liye U_m/volume = B²/(2μₒ)
Energy density = B²/(2μₒ) ... (17.38)

book_ref.quote: When the switch is turned ON, voltage is applied across the ends of coil

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein do ghaltiyan hain: average current (0+1)/2 chhapa hai, durust (0 + I)/2 = ½I hai; aur aik line mein U_m/volume = B²/μₒ chhapa hai jab ke durust B²/(2μₒ) hai, jaisa Eq. 17.38 mein.

blocks.prompt:
26 A solenoid of inductance 0.06 H carries a current of 5 A, and the field inside it is 0.2 T. Taking μₒ = 4π × 10⁻⁷ T m A⁻¹, find (i) the energy stored (ii) the energy density inside it. (iii) What does the energy become if the current is doubled? (3 marks)
(0.06 H inductance wale solenoid mein 5 A current hai aur andar field 0.2 T hai. μₒ = 4π × 10⁻⁷ T m A⁻¹ lein aur nikalein (i) store energy (ii) andar energy density. (iii) Current dugni karne par energy kitni ho jayegi?)
blocks.explanation: U_m = ½LI² aur energy density = B²/(2μₒ); U_m ∝ I², is liye I dugni to energy chaar guna.

book_ref.quote: This work is stored as potential energy in the inductor.

blocks.final_answer: U_m = 0.75 J; energy density = 1.59 × 10⁴ J m⁻³; 10 A par energy 3.0 J

blocks.prompt:
27 What is mutual induction? Derive the expression εₛ = −M ΔIₚ/Δt for the emf induced in the secondary coil. Define mutual inductance and the henry, and list the factors on which mutual inductance depends. (5 marks)
(Mutual induction kya hai? Secondary coil mein induced emf ka formula εₛ = −M ΔIₚ/Δt hasil karein. Mutual inductance aur henry define karein, aur woh cheezein likhein jin par mutual inductance munhasir hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Do coils aik doosre ke qareeb hain. Primary coil switch S aur rheostat ke zariye battery se judi hai; secondary galvanometer se judi hai. Rheostat se primary current badalne par ird gird magnetic flux badalta hai; yeh badalta flux secondary se bhi guzarta hai aur us mein emf induce karta hai.
Mutual induction: woh amal jis mein aik coil ki badalti current doosri coil mein emf induce kare.

Faraday's law se
εₛ = −Nₛ Δφₛ/Δt ... (17.39)
jahan Nₛ secondary ke turns hain. Secondary ka kul flux Nₛφₛ primary ke field ke mutanasib hai jo Iₚ ke mutanasib hai:
Nₛφₛ ∝ Iₚ, is liye Nₛφₛ = MIₚ ... (17.40)
jahan M (= Nₛφₛ/Iₚ) mutual inductance hai. Eq. 17.40 ko Eq. 17.39 mein rakhne se
εₛ = −Δ(Nₛφₛ)/Δt = −Δ(MIₚ)/Δt
εₛ = −M ΔIₚ/Δt ... (17.41)
Secondary ka emf primary ki current ki tabdeeli ki raftaar ke mutanasib hai; minus sign batata hai ke yeh primary ki current ki tabdeeli ki mukhalfat karta hai.

Mutual inductance: M = εₛ/(ΔIₚ/Δt) ... (17.42), secondary ke induced emf aur primary ki current ki tabdeeli ki raftaar ki nisbat. Unit V s A⁻¹ = henry: aik henry jab primary mein 1 A s⁻¹ ki tabdeeli secondary mein 1 V induce kare.

Factors: dono coils ke turns; cross-section ka area; darmiyani medium ki permeability; woh material jis par lapeti gayi hain; darmiyani faasla; orientation (rukh).
Istemal: transformers, motors, generators, pacemakers aur metal detectors.

book_ref.quote: Consider two coils close to each other as shown in Fig. (17.20).

blocks.prompt:
28 Two coils have a mutual inductance of 0.25 H. The current in the primary rises steadily from 0 to 3 A in 0.02 s. The secondary has 400 turns. Find (i) the emf induced in the secondary (ii) the flux through each turn of the secondary when the primary current is 3 A. (3 marks)
(Do coils ki mutual inductance 0.25 H hai. Primary current 0.02 s mein yaksaan tor par 0 se 3 A tak barhti hai. Secondary ke 400 turns hain. Nikalein (i) secondary mein induced emf (ii) primary current 3 A hone par secondary ke har turn ka flux.)
blocks.explanation: |εₛ| = M ΔIₚ/Δt; Nₛφₛ = MIₚ se φₛ = MIₚ/Nₛ.

book_ref.quote: where M is proportionality constant and is called Mutual inductance of the two coils
